recognize_zh: IgD 染色中，大結節內 IgD 陽性套層細胞（mantle cells）向內滲入、把生發中心切割成網狀的淡染碎片；下方的正常濾泡則是完整的 IgD 陽性套層環包住 IgD 陰性的生發中心，兩者對比正是 PTGC 的典型表現。
features: Enlarged nodule with IgD-positive mantle zone B cells extending into and permeating the germinal center
Germinal center broken into irregular, IgD-negative pale fragments giving a reticulated, moth-eaten pattern
Normal secondary follicle at the bottom with an intact IgD-positive mantle ring surrounding an IgD-negative germinal center (internal control)
Small IgD-positive ring-like follicle at the left edge
Interfollicular areas show only weak background staining
describe_en: IgD immunohistochemistry shows an enlarged nodule in which IgD-positive mantle zone B cells infiltrate the germinal center and break it into irregular IgD-negative fragments, producing a reticulated pattern with loss of the sharp mantle-germinal center boundary. By contrast, an adjacent normal secondary follicle shows an intact IgD-positive mantle cuff surrounding an IgD-negative germinal center. This pattern of mantle cell infiltration into a disrupted germinal center is characteristic of progressive transformation of germinal centers.

ddx.vs: NLPHL nodules also contain IgD+ small B cells, so the discriminator is the presence of LP cells (CD20+, OCT2+, BOB1+, EMA+, sometimes IgD+) rimmed by PD-1+ T cells within the nodules.
Follicular lymphoma follicles show attenuated or absent IgD-positive mantles around expanded IgD-negative neoplastic follicles, rather than IgD+ mantle cells invading a fragmented germinal center.

ddx.dx: Mantle cell lymphoma, mantle zone pattern
ddx.vs: Mantle cell lymphoma shows expanded monotonous cyclin D1/SOX11-positive mantle zones around naked germinal centers, not polytypic IgD+ cells infiltrating the center.
